proposals.evidence: DEDR 4939 gives Tamil muṭṭai, Malayalam muṭṭa/moṭṭa, Kannada/Tulu moṭṭe, Kodagu muṭṭe and Kota moṭ ‘egg’. These forms are distinct from guḍḍu and Gondi mēnj families. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
